up: Retrieve all IC50 activity records where the tested compound is Chloroquine (ChEMBL ID CHEMBL76) or any of its salt forms, and the target is Plasmodium falciparum (target_dictionary chembl_id = 'CHEMBL364'). For each record, provide the following fields: activity_id, compound ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), compound name (molecule_dictionary.pref_name), canonical SMILES, assay description, assay type, IC50 numeric value, IC50 units, relation (e.g., '=', '<', '>'), pChEMBL value, PubMed ID, DOI, journal name, and publication year. To include both Chloroquine and its salts, first locate the parent molecule using molecule_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL76', then obtain all molecules in molecule_hierarchy where parent_molregno equals that parent's molregno (this includes the parent itself). Connect these molecules to the activities table via the molregno field. Restrict to activities where standard_type = 'IC50'. Do not impose any additional filters; return all matching rows without a row limit.
sql:
SELECT
  a.activity_id,
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  md.pref_name AS compound_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  ass.assay_type,
  a.standard_value AS ic50_value,
  a.standard_units AS ic50_units,
  a.standard_relation AS relation,
  a.pchembl_value,
  d.pubmed_id,
  d.doi,
  d.journal,
  d.year AS publication_year
FROM molecule_dictionary parent_md
JOIN molecule_hierarchy mh ON mh.parent_molregno = parent_md.molregno
JOIN activities a ON a.molregno = mh.molregno
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid AND td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL364'
LEFT JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
LEFT JOIN docs d ON ass.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE parent_md.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL76'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50';
